feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.intro: Lumen has no feedback server. What you write here becomes a GitHub issue that you open yourself, or text that you copy. Nothing leaves this device until you click one of the two buttons at the bottom.
feedback.kind.question: A question
feedback.subject: Title
feedback.description.placeholder: What you did, what you expected, and what you saw instead
feedback.includeEnvironment: Include app and browser details (version, platform, language, AI policy)
feedback.includeDoctor: Include the AI doctor's report (checks of the local AI only, never note text)
feedback.doctorFailed: The AI doctor could not run: {error}
feedback.screenshot.hint: Your browser asks which screen, window or tab to capture. The picture is saved on this computer, not sent: attach it to the issue yourself. It may show your notes, so look at it first.
feedback.screenshot.saved: Saved {name}. Attach it to the issue.
feedback.screenshot.unsupported: this browser cannot capture the screen
feedback.openGithub.hint: Opens github.com in a new tab with the issue filled in. You need a GitHub account to submit it.
feedback.opened: GitHub opened in a new tab. Check the issue there and submit it.
feedback.tooLong: Too long for a link: the issue opens with the title only. The text is on your clipboard, so paste it into the issue.
feedback.copied: Copied. Paste it into an issue, an e-mail or wherever you like.
feedback.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text in the preview and copy it by hand.
